crime: At seven, holding her baby brother at the top of the stairs, {WITCH_NAME} told her mother she had pictured letting go. "If I can picture it, I'm the kind who would." After that, her mother stood between them, watching her hands.

A girl who once walked the rope in her family's traveling show now walked the upper railing every sunset. {WITCH_NAME} stood below calling each wobble before it came, and the walker called her "my eyes."
In the second-floor hall, {WITCH_NAME} confided that sometimes she pictured staying silent and watching the walker fall, slow as snow. The walker laughed. "A thought is just a thought."

The next sunset, in that hall, the walker told her kindly, "No need to watch tonight. Another girl will spot me from the hall." Her Magic slowed the walker's face frame by frame: the eyes dropped to her hands and away, as her mother's had.

At sunset she took a white pebble from the fountain basin and stayed there among the watchers, below the post where the walker turned. She watched the spotter's fingers crawl toward the ankle at the turn, and threw. The pebble hit the back of the walker's knee in the very frame those fingers closed. The walker pitched outward, head first onto the stone path.

Every eye was on the walker, none on the fountain. The prisoners saw the spotter's hand close on the walker's ankle as she fell, and in the trial court accused the spotter of pulling the walker off the railing.

Then a prisoner described what she found in the courtyard: green fountain silt on the back of the walker's knee, though the walker had come straight from the hall. The prisoners understood: a wet fountain stone had struck that knee in the very frame the spotter's fingers closed, a frame only the girl who watches the world crawl could have chosen.
fields.epitaph: A thought was only a thought until she threw it.
fields.epithet: The watcher afraid of her own hands
execution: The execution stand raised two tall posts in the trial court, with a tightrope hanging slack between them. The rope sagged into a loop around her neck as she stood beneath it. She called out each tremor of the rope, watching it straighten frame by frame. The rope drew taut and lifted her off the floor by the neck. She hung still from the middle of the straightened rope, turning slowly.

magic.name: Snowfall Sight
magic.text: Anyone or anything she watches slows to a crawl, while her thoughts run at full speed.
